newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSAPANK TO ISSUE NEW SHARES.
newsitem.headline: HANSAPANK TO ISSUE NEW SHARES.

text.p: Leading bank Hansapank said on Friday that it will propose a new issue of shares at its shareholder meeting.
It said in a statement that it will propose the issue of 19,121,780 shares of issue B at a nominal price of 10 kroons.
Shareholders will receive shares in proportion to their existing shareholding.
The issue will result in a rise in the bank's share capital to 382,435,600 kroons from 191,217,800 kroons, the bank added.
The shareholder meeting takes place on April 12.
"The new shares entitle their owners to dividends starting from the financial year which commences on January 1 1997," Hansapank said in a statement.
It said that the shares would be distributed on the basis of shareholdings registered on April 28 at nine o'clock.
"The shareholders will obtain the same amount of shares already owned by them on the afore-mentioned date," the bank added.
The bank also said the proposed dividend of 1.25 kroons a share would also be voted on at the shareholder meeting.
